evaluation.followup_requirement: After first success continue 50 control steps; report On, actual release, stability, carry motion and wall time separately.
evaluation.stop_rule: Do not promote on a successful demo alone; review failures and regressions against all controls.
evaluation.new_position_holdout: Choose and freeze additional offsets not in training and valid collision-free task geometry before first candidate evaluation; this preparation does not claim a final generalization suite.

data_handling: All originals/drafts/previous datasets preserved; no action scaling, no stitching, no synthetic speedup.
